rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential properties constructed on or before February 1, 1995.

rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords must have just cause to terminate a tenancy after 30 days and must provide relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies after 30 days, excluding housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, and certain other transient or institutional facilities.

rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
